title: Thermodynamic Properties of Diatomic Molecules from the Frost-Musulin Potential
summary: In this study, we present a quantum-statistical analysis of H$_2$ and LiH diatomic molecules within the Frost--Musulin potential framework. By combining the analytical bound-state approach to the radial Schrödinger problem with the near-equilibrium Pekeris representation, we obtain a validated rotation-vibration spectrum that reproduces a physically consistent ordering of energy levels.
